This updated index is then set through the same validation mechanism that ensures it only increases.

The key insight is that this formula guarantees the borrow index never decreases—it either stays the same when the interest rate is zero, or increases proportionally to the time elapsed and the current interest rate.

So both layers of protection catch time going backwards, though the arithmetic operation fails first.
